title: Task
description: Internal task format: one unit of work, normalised from the tracker it came from.

source.description: System the task came from, as a lowercase identifier, e.g. "jira", "linear", "github".

ticket_key.description: The ticket's key in its source system, exactly as the source writes it, e.g. "PAY-123" or "#42". Unique within a source.

type.description: Kind of work. bug: existing behaviour is wrong. feature: new behaviour. chore: no behaviour change (maintenance, refactoring, dependencies, tooling).

story.description: What is wanted and why, in prose. For a bug: what happens, what should happen, and how to reproduce it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions that must all hold for the task to be done. Each one is a single, checkable statement.

out_of_scope.description: Things that must not be done as part of this task, even if they look related.

pointers.description: Where to start looking: file paths relative to the repo root, symbols, URLs or short notes. Hints, not requirements.

repo.description: Repository the work lands in, as "owner/name".
